name: Fidelity Digital Dollar
oneLiner: FIDD is Fidelity Digital Assets' dollar stablecoin, issued under an OCC national trust charter and backed by cash and short-term U.S. Treasuries at BNY Mellon.
collateral: Cash, U.S. Treasury securities, and cash equivalents held at The Bank of New York Mellon
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Fidelity Digital Assets platforms

sources.label: PwC FIDD Reserve Attestation Report - May 2026

applicabilityBasis.summary: FIDD is a Fidelity-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin with 1:1 redemption and monthly reserve attestations, issued by a federally chartered OCC-supervised national trust bank.

genius.notes: Fidelity Digital Assets received a conditional OCC national trust bank charter approval on December 12, 2025 (conversion from NY state trust company). This is a trust-charter conditional approval under existing OCC chartering authority — it is not a PPSI approval under the GENIUS Act, which remains in proposed-rules rulemaking. No PPSI application framework exists yet and no issuer has received PPSI status. FIDD launched publicly on February 4, 2026; Fidelity positions FIDD as aligning with GENIUS Act reserve standards but has not announced a formal PPSI application.

The OCC conditional trust charter (Dec 12, 2025) confirms issuer pathway but is explicitly not a PPSI approval. No PPSI application framework exists; rulemaking is at NPRM stage.

mintAuthority.summary: FIDD is issuer-operated by Fidelity Digital Assets. The Ethereum token is a UUPS proxy with three DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOAs, five MINTER_ROLE EOAs, and one separate UPGRADER_ROLE EOA. There is no ProxyAdmin or timelock.

controls.label: Fidelity issuer-operated mint authority
controls.evidence: Fidelity describes FIDD as issued and supported by Fidelity Digital Assets under a full-service model covering issuance, purchases, redemptions, and reserves. All on-chain MINTER_ROLE holders are EOAs operated by Fidelity.

controls.label: FIDD Ethereum token (AccessControl)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, the implementation remained 0x8ae9cb3d9095da33555494110f567e3d974c6753 and the proxy-admin and beacon slots were zero. getRoleMemberCount() still returned three DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and five MINTER_ROLE holders, with the same addresses previously enumerated; eth_getCode returned empty bytecode for all eight.

controls.label: FIDD UPGRADER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, getRoleMemberCount(UPGRADER_ROLE) returned 1 and getRoleMember(...,0) returned this address; eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. Verified MintableToken source restricts _authorizeUpgrade() to UPGRADER_ROLE, so this single EOA can replace mint logic immediately.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, FIDD remained a UUPS proxy with implementation 0x8ae9cb3d..., zero proxy-admin and beacon slots, three default-admin EOAs, five minter EOAs, and one distinct upgrader EOA. Verified source gates _authorizeUpgrade() with UPGRADER_ROLE rather than DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: PwC examines FIDD reserves monthly; the latest available report covers 2026-05-29 and reconciles reserve assets to token liabilities. The OCC active national trust-bank list matches Fidelity Digital Assets, N.A. (charter 25398), the exact issuer.
